about: Starter list for "Add suggested creators": live streamers who invite clipping of their streams in public. Every proofUrl was fetched and every proofQuote found on it on the checkedOn date, with the same check the weekly job runs. Most proofs are open clipping-campaign pages (the creator or their agency invites anyone to clip; joining the campaign is only needed to be paid by it), one is the creator's own words in a news report. The big names are first; the smaller ones are not known GTA streamers and are here because the invitation is clear. Campaign pages change and close: the weekly check puts an entry on hold when its page or words are gone. Edit freely: an entry needs name, channels, proofUrl, proofQuote and checkedOn. Names, links and short quotes only, no media.

creators.name: Lacy
creators.proofQuote: Content must be sourced from any video/stream/clip featuring Lacy
creators.rules: Lacy must be the main focus. Name Lacy in the caption or on-screen text and use #Lacy. Never show him in a bad light, no hate farming, no logos. Post only on TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts and X. Join the campaign on the page to be paid.
creators.note: Big variety streamer. Proof: the rules page of his open clipping campaign ("A Reach Campaign · Powered by Lacy").

creators.name: Clix

creators.rules: Footage from 2026 onwards only, Clix as the main focus. Name Clix in the caption or on-screen text and use #Clix. creators.name: HasanAbi
creators.proofQuote: I have basically given up my intellectual property completely
creators.rules: He asks for a link back to his Twitch and socials, above all when the clips earn money.
creators.note: Top Twitch streamer who has played GTA RP. Proof: his own words on stream, quoted by TheGamer in August 2022 ("I want them to be able to keep monetizing"). An older statement: read it before relying on it.
